newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean Samsung Eng, other IPO begins trading.
newsitem.headline: South Korean Samsung Eng, other IPO begins trading.

text.p: Samsung Engineering Co shares began trading for the first time on Tuesday at a base price of 40,000 won per share, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
The base price is the weighted average of bids and offers received by the exchange and sets the trading range for the first day.
Samsung Engineering's 1.86 million new shares were initially offered at a price of 23,000 won per share on November 19-20.
Office equipment maker Sindoricoh Co Ltd's 62892.KS 2.88 million new shares had a base price of 52,000 won. They were subscribed at 39,000 won.
Kukdong City Gas Co Ltd listed 1.8 million new shares at a base price of 35,000 won. The initial offer price was 22,000 won.
Kuk Dong Corp, a textile wholesaler, listed 360,000 shares at a base price of 18,000 won, against a subscription price of 15,000 won.
Sewon Chemical Co Ltd's 442,320 shares were listed at a base price of 21,500. They were initially offered at 18,000 won.
Furniture maker Fursys Inc listed 920,000 shares at a base price of 41,200 won, compared to a subscription price of 35,000 won.
Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co Ltd listed 280,000 shares at 20,000 won. The shares had a subscription price of 15,000 won.
Muhak Alcohol Co Ltd's 21041.KS 260,000 shares were given a base price of 18,000 won, against a subscription price of 14,000 won.
